values.note: 52 sites, 13 of them tent-only (5 walk-to); the rest back-in or parallel drive-in sites on paved spurs. Vehicle + trailer + hitch 30 ft maximum.

values.note: Flush toilets and drinking water in season only; no RV fresh-water fill or dump (use Moraine Park or Glacier Basin). Generators only in Loop C, 7:30-10 a.m. and 4-8:30 p.m. No wifi; cell service unreliable.

values.note: Reservation only. Some sites open 6 months ahead on a rolling window, others only 2 weeks or 1 week ahead. Seven nights a year maximum.

Max length: NPS 'rvMaxLength 30' and recreation.gov 'Vehicles larger than 30-feet are not permitted' (vehicle + trailer + hitch). Stored 35 was wrong; set 30. EKKO's 23 ft fits. The catalog's per-site lengths are unusable (values 1-2).

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): weak lead. The Fall River runs in a rocky channel along the north edge of the campground; drive-in sites 045 and 046 are ~43-49 m from it (OSM), 041/042 ~55-62 m, with trees and a slope between on imagery; walk-to tent sites C/D/E are 34-40 m. Not obviously on the bank; a re-audit could look at riverside/view for the 045/046 area.
